noLan: No private IPv4 address found on the RaceHubOS server. No localhost QR code will be created.
chooseAddress: Select a LAN address (for example Wi-Fi rather than Docker/VPN).
lanHint: For devices on the same LAN. Reachability depends on the network, firewall and selected interface.
includeKey: Include director credential in QR code
keyWarning: This QR code grants full race-director control. Only show it on a trusted home network; do not photograph or forward it.
keyRequired: Enter a director credential of at least 32 characters.
